Who We Are

An innovative mental health organisation making Mental Well-being accessible

PsychTalks is based in Chattogram, dedicated to making psychology and mental health education accessible and engaging — particularly for young people. Our mission is to break down the barriers of stigma and misinformation surrounding mental health by providing reliable, culturally relevant, and easy-to-understand resources.

We empower individuals with the knowledge and tools to improve their well-being, foster personal growth, and build a more informed, supportive community.

Why PsychTalks

More Than an Internship

01
Real Impact, Real Work
You won't be fetching coffee. Your work will directly shape how thousands of young Bangladeshis understand and talk about mental health.
02
Grow Your Craft
Learn from experienced practitioners, psychology researchers, and creative professionals. Build a portfolio of work you'll be genuinely proud of.
03
A Community of Purpose
Join a tight-knit team of people who believe in the mission. Build lasting friendships and professional networks across disciplines.
04
Culturally Grounded
We create for Bangladesh, in Bangla and English. Our work respects and reflects local realities — not imported, out-of-context mental health content.
05
Flexible & Dynamic
We're a young, fast-moving organisation. Bring your ideas — the best ones will actually get made. Bureaucracy is minimal; initiative is celebrated.
06
Certificate & Recognition
Receive a formal certificate of internship, public recognition, and strong recommendation letters upon successful completion of your cohort.
